create.name: Kokilāvana
create.about: Kṛṣṇa called like a cuckoo (kokila) here to bring Śrī Rādhā out to meet Him; Ratnākara-sarovara is here.

create.name: Chatravana (Chātā)
create.about: Here the sakhās made Kṛṣṇa their king and held an umbrella (chatra) over Him. Nearby are Narī-Semarī and the Kiśorī-kuṇḍa of Umrāo, where Lokanātha Gosvāmī found the deity of Rādhā-Vinoda.

create.name: Kosī (Kosīvana)
create.about: Nanda's treasury (kosa) was kept here; Gomatī-kuṇḍa is in the town.

create.name: Khadiravana (Khāyaro)
create.location: Three miles south of Chātā and three miles south-east of Jāvaṭa (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Kṛṣṇa herded His cows here. At Saṅgama-kuṇḍa, where the gopīs met Kṛṣṇa, Lokanātha Gosvāmī did sādhana-bhajana in a solitary place, sometimes with Bhūgarbha Gosvāmī.

create.name: Śeṣaśāyī
create.about: Here Śrī Rādhā and the sakhīs saw Kṛṣṇa as Viṣṇu lying on Ananta Śeṣa in the ocean of milk; the deity of Anantaśāyī Viṣṇu is here.

create.name: Rāma-ghāṭa
create.about: On the Yamunā, where Baladeva performed His rāsa-līlā with the gopīs during His visit to Vraja and pulled the Yamunā with His plough.

create.name: Akṣayavaṭa
create.about: The «undying banyan», one of the sixteen banyan trees of Vraja, where Kṛṣṇa and the cowherd boys rested and played.

create.name: Tapovana (Gopī-ghāṭa)
create.about: The young gopīs performed austerities (tapas) here, worshipping Kātyāyanī to get Kṛṣṇa as their husband.

create.name: Nanda-ghāṭa
create.about: Where Nanda Mahārāja, bathing in the Yamunā at the wrong hour, was taken by Varuṇa's servant, and Kṛṣṇa went to Varuṇa-loka to bring him back.

create.name: Bhadravana
create.about: One of the twelve forests of Vraja, on the east bank of the Yamunā, where Kṛṣṇa herded cows and played with the sakhās.

create.name: Bhāṇḍīravana
create.about: Under the Bhāṇḍīra banyan Balarāma killed Pralambāsura; here, it is said, Brahmā performed the gāndharva marriage of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.

create.name: Bilvavana (Bel-vana)
create.location: Across the Yamunā from Vṛndāvana (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Lakṣmī-devī performs austerities here, wishing to enter Kṛṣṇa's rāsa-līlā.

create.name: Māna-sarovara (Vraja)
create.about: Where Śrī Rādhā hid in Her māna and Kṛṣṇa, in separation, came to pacify Her; a temple with paintings of the pastime is here.

create.name: Lohavana
create.location: Across the Yamunā from Mathurā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Kṛṣṇa killed the demon Lohajaṅgha here; Kṛṣṇa-kuṇḍa and the āśrama of Durvāsā are here.

create.name: Dāūjī (Baladeva)
create.about: The temple of Dāūjī — Śrī Baladeva with Revatī-devī — installed by Vajranābha; Kṣīra-sāgara (Balabhadra-kuṇḍa) is behind it.
